footprint_rows_tiles: bottom edge below origin; 1.5 = on the footprint
lens-working-glow_white_px: pixels the working light clipped to white; 0 = the light keeps its colour
lens-no-fluid-glow_white_px: pixels the working light clipped to white; 0 = the light keeps its colour
mech_cycle: frames of a closed loop; no positional check
riser-light_white_px: the most pixels of the light, in any frame, clipped to white; 0 = it keeps its colour
riser-light_clipped_px: the most pixels, in any frame, the light drives to white added over 'riser' on the plate; 0 = nothing clips
riser-light_frames: its frames and its plate layer 'riser''s: equal
riser-light_edge_px: the most pixels, in any frame, of the light (bloom and all, above GLOW_FLOOR 2) on the canvas's edge; 0 = the tail fades out inside it
riser-light_light: frame 0: peak luminance, core % (>= 60 % of the peak), halo % (<= 25 %); vanilla's glows: peak 87-171, core 2-8, halo 77-88
glass-light_white_px: the most pixels of the light, in any frame, clipped to white; 0 = it keeps its colour
glass-light_clipped_px: the most pixels, in any frame, the light drives to white added over 'glass' on the plate; 0 = nothing clips
glass-light_frames: its frames and its plate layer 'glass''s: equal
glass-light_edge_px: the most pixels, in any frame, of the light (bloom and all, above GLOW_FLOOR 2) on the canvas's edge; 0 = the tail fades out inside it
glass-light_light: frame 0: peak luminance, core % (>= 60 % of the peak), halo % (<= 25 %); vanilla's glows: peak 87-171, core 2-8, halo 77-88
frame0_vs_still: max channel difference, and share of pixels over 8 (sampling noise)
cut_px: per render, the px with alpha the footprint cut (E, W) cleared or thinned; the shadow is never cut
rolloff_px: per sheet but a shadow's or a light's, the px the highlight roll-off changed (brightest channel over 236, eased under 244, hue kept) and the most a channel moved; render.json's rolloff false opts out
